construction.minimum_rigidity_note: Use dimensionally stable panels and verify all measured point coordinates after assembly; nominal CAD coordinates are not measurement truth.

fiducials.print_rule: Print at 100 percent scale. Reject a panel when either printed check dimension differs from its nominal value by more than 0.20 mm.
fiducials.parity_rule: Reflected regions must be tested under both parity hypotheses before marker decoding; the retained hypothesis must agree with calibrated mirror geometry.

calibration.rule: Use ChArUco corners whose global corner index modulo 5 is 0, 1, or 2.

validation.rule: Use ChArUco corners whose global corner index modulo 5 is 3.

holdout.rule: Use ChArUco corners whose global corner index modulo 5 is 4; never use these points to estimate intrinsics, mirror planes, target pose, or model hyperparameters.

measurement.minimum_method: Measure a documented set of cross-face distances and panel orthogonality independently of the vision reconstruction.
measurement.preferred_method: Coordinate measuring arm, photogrammetric survey with an independently calibrated setup, or another traceable dimensional method.
measurement.warning: Generated nominal coordinates are construction coordinates only. They must not be used as held-out physical truth until the assembled target has been measured.
